dimensions.rationale: Actually operated public cooling and cleaner-air support, completed water seismic upgrades and backup power, and a completed Sea Island dike upgrade connect major local hazards to implemented protection. Heat, smoke, earthquakes, flood exposure, ageing assets and common power/climate dependencies remain. Planned reservoir/tunnel/filtration work and future dike/pump projects are not already effective safeguards.
dimensions.assumption: Accept limited municipal and shared essential-service protection as reasonably representing usually usable thermal, flood, weather and seismic mitigation for ordinary 375 residents, with geographic reach and continuity through 2026-10-10. This is not measured safe housing for every household or a guarantee of surviving a major earthquake. Important inadequately mitigated exposure can support 40; stronger effective independent safeguards can support 80. Reject scope, usual housing/cooling, current service applicability or remaining-risk significance to null.

dimensions.rationale: VPD reports actual weapon-related and violent chronic shoplifting harms alongside targeted organised-crime operations and scoped patrol responses. A selected neighbourhood’s violent incidents fell in October–December 2024, without an organised-violence-specific causal rate. Conflict-related protest policing and real 2025 vehicle barriers at post-incident events add scoped protection. The event review explicitly cannot verify deterrence; the severe April 2025 harm and sustainability limits remain.
dimensions.assumption: Accept the bounded links between actual violent or coercive retail harms, targeted response, managed conflict-related gatherings and implemented crowd protection as supporting continuing usually limited residual organised, regional and strategic effects for ordinary residents. Organised fencing/property decline does not by itself close organised violence; 937 protests are not all violent and April’s incident is not assumed organised or foreign-directed. Scope, continuity and residual-impact significance are necessary withdrawable inferences. Current important unmitigated targeted constraints can support 40; stronger effective protection can support 80; reject the connections to null. No war, successful strategic attack or complete 2026 population survey gate.

dimensions.rationale: Real seasonal coordination, wellness checks, multilingual cooling/air-cleaner outreach, completed essential-service maintenance and a published post-event review with implemented modifications support adaptation and scoped community access. The review separates actions from recommendations and acknowledges resource and protection limits. Programme counts do not prove full cohesion or universal crisis recovery.
dimensions.assumption: Accept finite municipal, police and essential-service implementation as reasonably representative of ordinarily usable coordination and adaptive public service in 375, with continuity and access for the ordinary resident. Important unmitigated exclusion or coordination/recovery failure can support 40; stronger effective backup and recovery can support 80. Reject usual reach, effects, geographic fit or continuity to null. No institutional reputation or attendance-count bonus.

dimensions.rationale: Operating multi-catchment water, treatment/repair and critical backup support real supply. The 2023 Vancouver HSDA adult food-insecurity figure of 17% includes financially constrained moderate and severe experiences; it is not an exact 2026 median-income citizen or FUA measure. Its continuing material net-access effect versus usually adequate affordable supply is unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Do not select 40 or 60 from the percentage or the mere existence of markets. Either discussion branch needs a reasoned ordinary-income, scope, time and remaining-constraint connection alongside actual mitigation. No majority-harm, full household-bill or perfect-cohort prerequisite; unresolved does not mean poor capability.

dimensions.rationale: Ordinary MSP payment rules and a specific CAR-T referral, eligibility and follow-up pathway are verified. A whole ordinary necessary-care quality, timely access and continuity judgment has not been accepted. CIHI’s public page supplies updated methods and a dynamic placeholder, while its raw workbook and HTML were 403; no local readmission values were obtained. The old VCH anaesthesia search excerpt is not a read clinical result.
dimensions.assumption: Keep the whole dimension unknown, without scoring access failures as medical incapacity. A limited selected clinical delivery/quality or outcome connection plus ordinarily usable payment, referral, timing and continuity can support a conditional 60, as in existing cases; important actual unmitigated necessary-care barriers can support 40 and stronger effective affordable backups can support 80. This does not require all ages, all diseases, perfect net bills or risk-adjusted full-FUA measurement. The missing connection here is an accepted actual ordinary-care quality/timeliness/continuity path, not the hospital’s existence. Reject necessary connections to keep null with alternatives empty.

dimensions.rationale: BC Cancer documents standard adult CAR-T available since January 2024, with capacity constraints and possible out-of-province referral. Dated August 2026 disease eligibility connects active MSP and clinical criteria to funding; October 2025 follow-up guidance specifies investigations, infection precautions and lifelong monitoring. A 2024 primary announcement includes actual prior human trial patient reports, while its 20 adult/5 child yearly figures are anticipated, not a treated count.
dimensions.assumption: Accept the real limited local human programme, current standard-care availability and named disease funding/referral pathway as continuing mature translation for clinically eligible ordinary residents. Infer usual implementation of specialist monitoring and normally bearable net treatment/support costs from that concrete operating pathway, not MSP or budgets alone. Capacity, travel stability, clinician tests, approval/appeal and non-funded preventive costs remain important. No independent complete infusion cohort, product-registry reread or monitoring-adherence/net-invoice audit was obtained. Actual important delivery, payment or monitoring bottlenecks can support 40; stronger usable effective access can support 80. Reject maturity, local delivery, cutoff version, eligibility, net access or continuity to null.

dimensions.rationale: The dated April 2025 UBC primary body reports over 500 active licences and actual historical products and company activity. Current undated stock counts are not silently treated as pre-cutoff output. Actual municipal multilingual DIY-air-cleaner workshops and resident equipment use, plus implemented utility digital operations, connect technology to scoped diffusion. WIPO remains activity context rather than a FUA metric or preset score.
dimensions.assumption: Accept the local institution-to-industry connection and finite resident/provider applied technology as reasonably representative of ordinarily usable capability and diffusion for 375, with current operating continuity. Institution totals across campuses, companies remaining in Canada and product sales are not local market shares or resident outcomes. Important unmitigated industry, digital or access barriers can support 40; stronger effective independent infrastructure and wider usable diffusion can support 80. Reject scope, usual access or remaining-constraint significance to null; no perfect all-resident adoption measurement prerequisite.

dimensions.rationale: Actual Vancouver YVR2025 transport operation and existing airport core-network/back-up protection independently combine with applicable Canadian legal procedure, Canadian-resident banktransfer/recipient/FX/reporting rules and actually launched roaming/current WiFi and bankauthentication pathways. These establish conditional workable transport, lawful relocation, asset access and continued links rather than just an airport or passport count. Qualified residence purpose, net costs, Canadian-residency changes, service/recipient restrictions and shared airport/bank/network/account dependencies remain material.
dimensions.assumption: Accept the finite same-level inference that an ordinary long-term Canadian citizen at median income normally can use an actually qualifying destination/residence purpose and passport, existing eligible accounts and lawful available own funds, compliant recipient arrangements, compatible postpaid/device/data or WiFi/authentication and bearable transport/FX/communication costs. German section41 is entry/in-country application within90days, not approved residence/work; sections2/4a/5/18/18b purpose, subsistence and work requirements are necessary and no particular youth, retirement, profession or wealthy-investor profile is assumed. CIBC GMT requires Canadian residency: infer feasible lawful initial transfer while eligible and receiving/continuing arrangements, not automatic continued GMT after becoming nonresident or instant portability of all assets. Current undated source continuity/cutoff-version, usual resident uptake and remaining affordability/continuation are explicit withdrawable assumptions. FINTRAC CAD10000 reporting is not a citizen transfer ban/quota. Roaming and WiFi share carrier/account/device/foreign-network dependencies; RBC mandatory authentication alternatives are conditional, not universally recoverable. Published2015 WiFi emergency wording is historical and differs current Canada/US help. Important remaining lawful/affordable exit or continuity constraints can support40; stronger actually usable independent alternatives80. Reject any necessary legal-purpose, ordinary access, funds/receiver/payment, version, geographical, affordability or continuation bridge to whole-dimension null and clear alternatives. No Toronto airport evidence or city score is transferred.
